name: Danang Marriott Resort & Spa, Non Nuoc Beach Villas
short_description: Marriott's first all-villa oceanfront resort in Vietnam, on Da Nang's Non Nuoc Beach, with 122 two-to-four-bedroom private-pool villas beside the Marble Mountains.
ai_summary: The Non Nuoc Beach Villas is an all-villa property occupying the same beachfront complex as the main Danang Marriott Resort tower, but sold under its own Bonvoy code. Independent reviewers consistently describe it as Marriott's first all-villa oceanfront resort in Vietnam, converted from the former Vinpearl wellness villas, with 122 private-pool villas of two to four bedrooms ranging from roughly 328 to 425 square metres. Points-and-miles writers single it out as a genuine sweet spot, with spacious two-bedroom garden villas bookable from around 30,000 Bonvoy points, delivering strong redemption value against high cash rates. Families are the core audience: reviewers praise the M Passport activity programme, the Kids Club, in-villa picnics and beach play, plus the fun of a private plunge pool at each villa. Dining across five outlets, the Quan Spa's traditional Vietnamese treatments, and warm, attentive service also draw repeated praise, alongside a generous breakfast buffet. Watch-outs are fair rather than damning: the resort sits in the quieter Ngu Hanh Son area about 12 km from central Da Nang, so city dining and nightlife require a drive; some villas and furnishings show their pre-conversion age; and complimentary internet is tied to Bonvoy membership. TripAdvisor places it around four stars. Overall the property reads as a spacious, private, family-oriented villa retreat that rewards points bookers, provided guests accept a somewhat out-of-town setting.

faqs.question: Is this the same as the main Danang Marriott Resort & Spa?
faqs.answer: No. The Non Nuoc Beach Villas is a separate all-villa property sharing the same beachfront complex as the main Danang Marriott Resort & Spa tower. It carries its own Bonvoy property code (MARSHA dadnn) and offers only multi-bedroom private-pool villas rather than standard hotel rooms, so confirm which one you book.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from Da Nang International Airport?
faqs.answer: The villas sit about 12 km south of Da Nang International Airport in the Ngu Hanh Son district, typically a 20-minute drive. They are a short distance from the Marble Mountains and roughly 20 km north of Hoi An Ancient Town, so day trips to both attractions can be arranged easily from the resort.

faqs.question: What are the villas like?
faqs.answer: Every unit is a private-pool villa of two to four bedrooms, ranging from about 328 to 425 square metres. Each has its own plunge pool, multiple ensuite bathrooms, a full living and dining area, and garden or ocean views, making them well suited to families and groups travelling together.
